LanguageData.Gun_M3A1_RWP.description: The M3A1, also known as the "Grease Gun," is a compact submachine gun known for its simplicity and reliability. It offers moderate stopping power with a high rate of fire, making it effective in close-quarters combat. Though its accuracy decreases over longer distances, its lightweight design allows for increased mobility. Ideal for raids and defensive situations where quick reaction times are crucial.
